headline: New Stock Trading System Starts Today; Full Summary of Changes from Existing Methods
summary: From today, after-hours trading runs from 4 to 8 PM and the off-hours single-price trading method is abolished, with real-time execution introduced. ETFs and ETNs are excluded.
why: The Korea Exchange operates South Korea's main stock markets, and changes to trading hours and execution methods affect how investors access and price shares.
